title: A member who moves to a new phone and joins the gym again becomes a second member, and the old one stays
what: The gym link lives only on the phone. On a new phone, a reinstall or the move from the old app, the member joins again with the code or the number and the gym makes a brand-new member. The old one is never removed: it stays on the gym's member list and on the leaderboard with the last 30 days of workouts, the new one starts at zero, challenge progress starts again, past orders are gone and the gym's recent messages show as unread again.
expected: Joining again from a new phone picks up the same member (found by the checked mobile number or by the gym's list), or at least retires the old one, so the member keeps one place on the board, one challenge count and one message history.
who: members who change or reset their phone, and their gyms
fix_line: When a member joins again with a mobile number the gym already has, reuse or retire the old member instead of adding a second one

title: A long-time member who reinstalls or changes phone gets 'Welcome to the gym' as if new
what: The welcome reminder counts anyone who joined the gym in the app in the last 7 days as new. A member of two years who reinstalls, changes phone, or leaves and comes back joins again in the app, so the next morning the phone says 'Welcome to <gym>! Your plan and the gym's news are in MettleUp.'
expected: The welcome goes only to someone new to the gym: the gym's own joining date or a first plan decides, not the day this phone joined in the app.
how_often: every rejoin, while the welcome switch is on (on by default)
fix_line: Send the welcome only when the gym's records say the member is new, not when this phone joined

items.reason: Update over older versions is safe: saved gym data is read field by field, old reminder ids are cancelled, old pop-ups are not replayed, old link addresses still open; parts wait for the server. Moving to a new package or phone loses the gym link and splits the member (01; old ForgeAI package already FN-B-time-phone-screens-1-01). No watch part and no web page cache in this area.

Gym paused and member removed are handled; leap day and year end are handled in reminders; plan end and long absence reuse existing stale-copy findings; phone change and leave-and-return split the member (01). No trial in this area; staff sign-in is hidden.
New-only flows found: membership link by number, home-screen icon offer right after joining, app welcome.
Existing members get 'Check in once to link your membership' and the icon stays in Settings, Your gym.
Every new-only flow has a path for existing members; no finding.
A new member's bell counts only the gym's last 14 days of messages and old ones never pop up; no new-feature dots in this area. The welcome reminder treats a returning member as new.
Welcome to a long-time member after a reinstall (02); old messages unread again after a rejoin (part of 01).
